evidence: Read-only comparison of experiments/ptr-engine/measure/rows-e1-spcc-2026-11-10.jsonl (commit e18a587, run_id e1-spcc-2026-11-10-spcc-r1) against the spcc rows of experiments/ptr-engine/measure/rows-e1-final-2026-11-10.jsonl (commit e4692f8, run_id e1-final-2026-11-10-spcc-r1), joined on turn 1..100. prompt_sha256 EQUAL at all 100 turns; prompt_tokens EQUAL at all 100 turns; fixture_sha256 f0a636fea0f82b152e8d23f0f51a9fb0f38479eabd40290e73bd98ebd3e620c3 identical in both; layer_tokens, epoch, compactions, masked_rows, evicted, expected_present, fetch_rows, fetch_tokens, fetch_policy, fetch_budget_tokens, claim, digest_at, engine, channel_token_method, comparison_eligible all equal at all 100 turns; seed 42, temperature 0.0, model occamy-1.0, endpoint http://192.168.2.168:8012/v1, max_tokens 4096, top_p None, rep 1 identical; error=None and cap_refused_mid_turn=None on all 200 rows; finish_reason=stop on all. Answers differ at exactly 6 turns: 5, 41, 52, 57, 60, 80 - every one on a byte-identical prompt. content_sha256 and content_tokens differ at exactly those same 6 turns (response bytes moved, request bytes did not). Only turns 57 and 60 are scored: T57 checkpoint cp.TX-03.f06.d5 expected 3501, A answered ANSWER: NONE (verified False) vs B ANSWER: NUM 3501 (verified True); T60 checkpoint cp.TX-03.f06.d8 expected 3503, A ANSWER: NONE (verified False) vs B ANSWER: NUM 3503 (verified True). Those two turns are the entire 20/48 -> 22/48 value delta and, because longrun/score_longrun.py:1235 defines contract_ok = (ak == 'NUM' and value_ok), also the entire 19/48 -> 21/48 contract delta. No prompt divergence point exists. Request is stateless per longrun/run_longrun.py:1499 (messages() returns only the constant fixture system prompt plus the single user prompt, no prior assistant turns), and prompt_sha256 is sha256_text(info['prompt']) at run_longrun.py:3723, so equal hashes plus equal fixture_sha256 mean byte-identical request bodies. Git range e18a587..e4692f8 touches only run_longrun.py (260 insertions, 37 deletions); ptr_engine/layers.py and longrun/arm_cd.py are unchanged (0 lines) and longrun/tasks-v7/TX-03.v1.json is unchanged. Hunks land at RequestCapGate (596/604/633/676), build_cap_gate (742), followups_spent (1223), fetch_rounds (1347), run_cell (3348/3397/3472/3503/3588), build_parser (4017), main (4136) - none in Planner (starts run_longrun.py:1474) or any prompt-construction code; the run_cell hunks are confined to the CapRefusal/BudgetExhausted row-persistence exit paths, and neither path fired in either cell. Corroborating mechanism: cached_tokens differ at 26 of 100 turns on byte-identical prompts (turns 1,2,3,5,8,10,24,30,33,45,51,53,54,55,56,57,58,59,61,67,69,70,71,74,77,89; total cached 79808 in A vs 81024 in B, 22 of 26 with B higher), so the serving stack's prefix-cache occupancy and batch composition differed between runs. VERDICT: genuine nondeterminism, server-side. Consequence: temperature 0 plus seed 42 is not a reproducibility contract on this endpoint; measured per-turn flip rate 6/100 (6%), per-scored-checkpoint flip rate 2/48 (4.2%), run-to-run spread on the headline metric +/-2/48 = +/-4.2 pp. A single-rep cell therefore carries a noise floor of at least 4.2 pp on this fixture, so E1 at reps=1 cannot distinguish 20/48 from 22/48 and cannot support any arm-to-arm claim smaller than that band; the 20/48 and 22/48 cells are the same treatment and their gap is pure noise, confirming U-SPCC-44's assertion with turn-level proof. Divergence clusters on the fact-06 block (T52, T57, T60 all flipped together while 94 turns were stable), so the effective independent sample is below 48 and fact-level variance is worse than the aggregate 4.2 pp. The bounded-context-fetch degenerate cell (43/48 stranded fetch_followup rows, tools_mode=off, send_index 0 on all 100 rows) is a separate deterministic defect and must not be filed under this finding. Zero model requests spent; scores recomputed from the rows matched the recorded 20/48 and 22/48 exactly.
